content.text:
Text messages are now cut to 160 characters, and the full test suite passes (62 tests, including two I added).

In `lib/notices/compose.js`, `composeNotice` now checks the body when the notice goes by SMS. If the body is longer than 160 characters, it keeps the first 157 and adds `...`. Email notices are unchanged. Every notice goes through `composeNotice`, including hold-ready, due-soon and overdue, so all of them are covered.

Characters are counted as Unicode code points rather than UTF-16 units. A title with an emoji or other non-BMP character therefore won't be cut in the middle of a character.

The two new tests are in `test/notices.test.js`:
- **Long SMS:** a 200-character title gives an SMS body of exactly 160 characters ending in `...`. The same text by email is left whole.
- **Exact fit:** an SMS body of exactly 160 characters is left alone.
